selection: Sixteen analytical cases selected before their full evaluation, after generation and independent replay of the development cross-codebook case. T07 and T08 were restricted before lock to reserve replay headroom after the measured checking pilot. The received-word obstruction remains in T02; no statistical workload-breadth claim is made.
scope: Proof-carrying finite-frontier evaluation for the exact locked grammar plus a complete external printed-constraint census; no generic MO-MaxSAT, physical-design, asymptotic, or statistical-generalization claim.
